name: Takahama (Fukui, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Takahama town emblem in white: a six-pointed star enclosing a ring with a lozenge.
history: Municipal flag of Takahama, a town in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1964.

features.role: Takahama town emblem — a six-pointed star enclosing a ring with a lozenge
